info.description: Home lab dashboard: network discovery, a map of hosts, bookmarks, views and docs
info.title: Gimlé API

get.description: Retrieve all hosts from the database
Copies of the database and settings, newest first. They stay in the data folder and are never offered for download, since they hold connector and docs tokens.

post.description: Puts back the database and settings, keeping the address and port in use. The current state is backed up first, so a restore can be undone.

get.description: Addresses added by hand, with their tags and the host they are linked to

post.description: ID 0 creates one. URL must be http(s). Mac links it to a host, Port to one of its services. Tags replace the bookmark's tags.

delete.description: Also removes it from every group it was tagged into

get.description: Categories Gimlé suggests for hosts and services, in display order

post.description: Category is one of GET /categories, or "" to go back to the suggested one

get.description: Returns the current configuration used by the app

post.description: An empty Token keeps the saved one; ClearToken removes it. The token is never sent back.
Page is "" for the network map, or "/view/auto", "/view/ID", "/hosts", "/stats" or "/bookmarks"

get.description: Docker, Dockhand, Scanopy, UniFi and Technitium sources. Tokens are never returned.

post.description: ID 0 creates one. An empty Token keeps the saved token; ClearToken removes it.

delete.description: Also removes the containers and ports it reported

post.description: Waits for the sync and returns the connector with its result

get.description: Containers the connectors reported, optionally for one host
Pages in the docs folder of the configured GitHub repository, following its mkdocs.yml nav when there is one. Repo is "" until docs are set up.

get.summary: An image from the docs folder

get.description: Rendered HTML plus the Markdown and blob sha an edit starts from

parameters.description: Page path inside the docs folder, e.g. hosts/nas.md
parameters.name: path

post.description: Needs editing turned on and a token that may write to the repository. Answers 409 when the page changed on GitHub since Sha.
post.summary: Commit a docs page to GitHub

get.description: Update a host's name and optionally toggle its "known" status

parameters.description: Pass 'toggle' to flip the known/unknown status
parameters.name: known

get.description: Retrieve the complete history of all hosts. Not recommended, the output can be a lot
Retrieve the latest history entries for a specific host by MAC address

parameters.description: Number of history entries to return
parameters.name: num

get.description:
Retrieve history for a specific host on a given date
The date format is flexible and can be:
- Year only: `2025`
- Year + month: `2025-09`
- Full date: `2025-09-06`
- Full timestamp: `2025-09-06 00:58:26`

parameters.description: Date filter (supports YYYY, YYYY-MM, YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss)
parameters.name: date

get.description:
Add host by MAC, with optional Name, IP, Hardware
Returns `models.Host` with this MAC form DB, either just added or existing
Remove a host from the database by its unique ID
Retrieve detailed information about a host by its unique ID

post.description: Port 0 is the host itself. Icon is a dashboard-icons name (e.g. "immich"), an image URL, "none", or "" to go back to the default
post.summary: Set the icon of a host or service

post.description: Kind "host" needs Mac, "service" needs Mac and Port. Bookmarks are tagged through /bookmarks

post.summary: Move an item earlier or later within its tag

get.description: Subnets and hosts with their subnet, saved map position and web services

delete.description: Forget all saved positions so every host is placed automatically

get.description: Trigger a test notification to verify notification settings
Check whether a given TCP port on an address is open or closed

200.description: true if open, false if closed

get.description: The ports a "top" port scan checks, with the service usually found on each
Stored open ports, when the host was last scanned, and the progress of a running scan

post.description: Scan a host in the background. Poll GET /ports/{id} for progress

parameters.description: top (default), all, or a list like 22,80,8000-8100
parameters.name: list

get.description: Manually trigger rescan
Online hosts and used addresses over time (hourly up to 7 days, daily beyond), uptime per host, and new hosts per day

parameters.description: Days to look back, today included (default 30)
parameters.name: days

parameters.description: Days to look back, today included (default 30)

get.description: Retrieve summary statistics of hosts, optionally filtered by interface
All configured subnets with their address usage

post.description: ID 0 creates a new subnet. Method is "arp" (scan with arp-scan) or "none" (track addresses only)

get.description: Suggest subnets from the IPv4 addresses on this machine's interfaces
Usage and the state of every address in a subnet (addresses omitted above 4096)
Every tag with how many hosts, services and links carry it
Tag items for a host and its services

200.description: port number (0 for the host) -> category

get.description: Returns the current running version of the application
Custom dashboard tabs in order

post.description: ID 0 creates a view at the end. Layout is "tiles" or "map"

get.description: Every web service, and every host without one, grouped by its suggested category. Needs no tags.

post.description: Tags every host and service that has no tag yet with its suggested category, and adds a "Categories" view showing those tags. Existing tags are left alone.
